featured_reviews.name: D. Rajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We used to buy our dresses here. Last time we bought Dresses 3 years ago.
Unfortunately this year the Dresses were in very bad shape. Not clean at all. Fitting was disaster and way too tight. Were told that they d dry clean it for us. When we picked up the clothes, they were still wet and Not satisfactory. Probably handwashed. The fitting was okay but we didnt feel like Fighting over It further as they didnt see the mistake. Because stitches were opened Up later with No care and roughness, there r a few holes from it. Were given many justifications for the Bad quality such as "its normal that the clothes have patches as we Display them".
Moreover the fitting is done on Road Side by the Tailor. The clothes get dirty there.
I wore one Dress today. Few stitches opened Up such as the zip...
We asked for a New Dress from the Same price Range. There were No genuine compromisses from their Side. Not coming here again. There r many other stores nearby where the price and quality is way better. Disappointed that the quality and service is so bad now.

featured_reviews.review_text:
RUTU THE FASHION LOUNGE is absolutely amazing! The collection is stylish, trendy, and perfect for every occasion—from casual wear to elegant outfits. The fabric quality is excellent, and the designs are modern yet very classy.

What truly stands out is the customer service. The staff is friendly, patient, and gives honest suggestions, making the shopping experience comfortable and enjoyable. Every visit feels special because they really understand fashion and customer needs.

featured_reviews.name: Aayushi Modi
featured_reviews.review_text: The staff here is incredibly helpful and patient, they truly go the extra mile to help you find a dress just the way you imagine. They assist you until you’re completely satisfied with your choice. The material quality is excellent, and there’s a wide variety of designs to choose from. Definitely a must-visit Rutu - The fashion lounge if you’re in or around Bhayandar West!

featured_reviews.name: Sanvika Gurav
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience at Rutu – The Fashion Lounge. The collection is trendy yet elegant, the fabric quality is excellent, and the fitting is absolutely perfect. The service is very professional and friendly, making customers feel comfortable and valued. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for stylish and quality fashion.

featured_reviews.name: Manav Chaturvedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing experience at Rutu!
Rutu has a beautiful collection of ladies’ Indian outfits with excellent quality and elegant designs. The variety is impressive, whether you’re looking for daily wear or something special for an occasion. The staff is very polite, helpful, and patient, making shopping here a pleasant experience. Prices are reasonable for the quality they offer, and the overall vibe of the store is warm and welcoming.
Highly recommended for anyone in Bhayandar looking for stylish and authentic Indian wear!

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Dhuri
featured_reviews.review_text: This place offers a great variety of outfits, catering to different styles and preferences — from casual wear to festive and traditional attire. What really stands out is the balance between quality and affordability; the prices are quite reasonable considering the variety and craftsmanship on display. During the festive season, the collection becomes even more vibrant, with plenty of new arrivals, seasonal discounts, and special offers. It's an ideal spot for anyone looking to refresh their wardrobe or find the perfect outfit for celebrations without breaking the bank. Highly recommend checking it out during festive shopping time — you’re likely to find something that suits your taste and budget
